svg.text: What a fragile car looks like

The same driver, the same corner, the same disturbance — five cars that differ only in where their weight sits. Each panel shows eight laps with steering noise and a grip surface that changes lap to lap.

[MEASURED] Episode 10's policy (experiments/ep10/out/policy.pt), DEPLOYED, nothing retrained - 120 rollouts per design (headline rates); 40 for the condition grid - [ASSUMED] steering noise sigma 0.01, grip +/-20% per lap - slip envelope penalised at 0.5

Cropped identically on every panel, to the corner and the corrections just after it. Coloured lines completed the lap; red lines left the road and the cross is where. The cars are not drawn because eight nearly coincident outlines hide the very thing being compared.
